reviews.comment: Lectures are super entertaining and everything he teaches applies to the real world. Tests are straight forward and he prepares you well.
He is really great! He's really personable and funny. He explains the material very well. Quizzes and exams have a cheat sheet. Lots of extra credit from the Kahoot at the end of each class.

The only grades are the four exams plus the 3 quizzes, but don't worry because he drops a quiz score and being able to just write the excel functions down on your cheat sheet already guarantees a good grade on the exams regardless of whether you really study or not. He's a great professor and you shouldn't take anyone else for stats.

Professor Miller is awesome. Class isn't mandatory, but he gives out kahoots at the end of each lecture that is later on worth a ton of extra credit. You also get to have a cheat sheet during your exams. He's a very fun, caring, and respectable prof and would definitely recommend to take him.

Dr. Miller is an amazing lecturer and easy to understand. He makes it clear on what to study and allows a cheat sheet on the exams/quizzes. Class is graded on exams and quizzes only (3 each with one quiz dropped) and gives extra credit!! Loved his class
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: An outstanding lecturer who makes a very boring subject actually interesting to learn. Graded by only exams and quizzes (allowed a cheat sheet), but they are very easy with minimal trick questions. A 100 is very achievable in this class, and that's not including all the extra credit he gives with the Kahoots we do at the end of every lecture.

There is not ONE homework assignment. Grade is 3 tests 3 quizzes. Never thought I'd even be rating a professor on here but I genuinely loved this teacher so much that I had to. He's funny, the class isn't too hard, I'd say if you didn't study at all you would make a B, but maybe minimal studying gets you an A. He is a KING!!! Take this class asap!!

Take him if you can! The class is only 3 quizzes and 3 exams but they are pretty easy if you study at all. You get a cheat sheet for each one. He makes the lectures super engaging and you can tell that he loves what he is teaching. I didn't know any excel before this class and he made it really easy to learn. GO TO CLASS! Extra credit from Kahoots!

He uses Excel for all exams and quizzes, rather by working it out by hand. Go to class because he offers extra credit, which is important in case you don't do well on the exams. No homework, basically no textbook, and a very funny guy. If you can, take Miller!!
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Just trust me, take this professor. No attendance, but you definitely don't want to miss his lectures. He is a great teacher, and if you give him 1 hour of your time 2 days a week in class, you will get an A. I also learned so much about applicable Excel.

HE IS HILAROUS, 100/10 take him hes really funny, amazing lectures and overall the class is really easy. Just one quiz before each of the three tests, you get a page cheat sheet for everything so its really easy. TAKE HIM.

attendance isn't mandatory but if you go and do the kahoots you get lots of extra credit on exams. he uses excel, not basic stats formulas and he shows you how to do everything in class. no homework, grade is from 2 quizzes (there are 3 but he drops one) and 3 exams. even though its exam heavy, you can use a cheat sheet on exams and quizzes

TAKE MILLER!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! He is hilarious and kind and really does everything he can to help you pass this class. He is an excellent explainer and does practice problems within lectures to make sure you're following ok. He also gives extra credit and no homework! Loved his class!

Professor Miller was an amazing professor. I highly recommend taking his class if you get the chance to take his honors ISTM class. He teaches Excel extremely well and is also a really funny prof. If you show up to every class and do the work, you will do well, and he also really wants you to succeed.

Loved his class!! Not the easiest concept wise but Dr. Miller's way of teaching and explaining help so much! He uses Excell often which makes learning Busn Stats easier to understand and to apply to real world scenarios. He's a new professor at A&M so I think my class got luck on the amount of extra credit, but he does give it!

Dr. Miller is the GOAT! I took his honors ISTM class, and I learned so much! His lectures are super engaging, and he explains every concept extremely thoroughly. The content isn't inherently easy, but his ability to convey information through the lectures makes the tests and quizzes a breeze! Would highly recommend taking him!!!

MY KING PROF MILLER. He is so awesome. This course is easy due to his ability to teach and allow us to use Excel to get to answers. I didn't take stats in HS, but I was able to pick up everything pretty easy. I suggest going to class because he does kahoot for extra credit DAILY. Also go to office hours and show him that you care! He is a great guy

Dr. Miller rocks! He taught our honors section and challenged us, but was also very realistic. He made this class engaging, and I strongly feel he taught us real life, tangible skills to use in our future careers. Take him!
He made statistics very easy to understand and taught us using Excel instead of doing calculations by hand. Overall great professor and a great guy! Take him!

Miller's material is lecture-heavy, and his exams and quizzes reflect what is covered in class. The course incorporates Excel throughout the semester, so be prepared with a computer that works with Microsoft Office. Attending class is beneficial due to extra credit opportunities.

Professor Miller is the GOAT. He takes a class that is normally memorizing formulas and regurgitating them onto a few exams just to forget about them into a fun and engaging class where you learn how to do statistics in excel and interpret the numbers in real ways. Gives extra credit opportunities every class so def go. Mad respect for this stud

Professor Miller was amazing! He made class engaging with his personality while also teaching the material effectively. We did kahoots at the end of each class which helped make sure you understood the material and they were given as extra credit if you got the right answer. He wants his students to succeed and makes exams and quizzes very clear.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Great guy, insane amount of extra credit given via Kahoot, so go to class. Exams were easy if you did light studying, I did not study for. exam 1 and did poorly as result. Made good grades on the others because he lets you use a cheat sheet. He teaches the class in a way that is actually useful after college, and I always learned something.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: He's the GOAT, very sweet and caring. Attendance is not mandatory but you should definitely go, he explains things thoroughly and he's very funny. Definitely recommend taking him if you don't want to stress over this class.

Was an incredible lecturer, explained and ensured everyone understood what was going on. He is approachable and cares for his students. Gave an insane amount of extra credit and cheat sheet on exams and quizzes. I learned more in his class about excel than in my actual excel class.

I mean it when I say this is the best class I've taken at Mays so far. Prof is funny and actually seems like a real person. SOO much extra credit if you go to class, cheat sheets on exams and quizzes, open excel. Easiest class I have ever taken I have like a 105 right now. Couldn't recommend more.

Very personable and gives a lot of extra credit, but you have to be in class to get it. Powerpoints are a little confusing and he shows a lot of how to do the material in excel in class so I would recommend showing up as you will know all the extra details that will be on the quizzes and tests. Overall great professor even though he is new.

Professor Miller might be one of the best professors I've had. Stats is not necessarily an easy course, but Miller makes it easy to understand. SHOW UP TO CLASS! I found that it was best to take notes on excel while Miller lectures/teaches because there is a lot to cover so it can be really easy to get behind if u take notes on something else.

He's new so you might be wary of taking him (I was) but he's in the top profs I had here. He makes everything way more simple than the textbook, is funny in class, understanding about any makeups, and gives a good amount of extra credit! He sets you up for success, especially since quizzes are like exams and great study material. Take him! Easy A

3 exams worth 83% of grade and 2 quizzes are 17%, he does kahoots at end of class for extra credit. You can bring a cheat sheet for quizzes and exams and one quiz get drops. He is a great professor, teaches well and wants you to succeed. He's also funny and likes to crack a few jokes. Ik people want M.Trindade bc of her rmp, but Miller is great too
